name: Limits meter
purpose: THE ALLOWANCE READING OF THE ONE METER MOLECULE. Use this when the value is a cap you are spending against and a full bar means BLOCKED, not done — payment, daily and monthly transfer limits, card spending caps. The geometry, the tokens, the states, the organism lock-ups and the full spec live ONCE, in meter.meta.json; this record exists so 'Limits meter' stays a findable, selectable identity in the catalogue with its own category, per s210-D5.

aliasOf.why: An allowance meter measures a ceiling you must NOT complete: full is a blocked payment. Identical geometry to the progress reading, inverted meaning — that inversion is the whole categorical difference Dave asked a selecting human or model to be able to see: 'the user, AI or User must understand the difference, even if it's only categorical.'

livesInside: Transfer / payment flows (before the amount is entered)
mustNotNeighbour: A Chart-bullet showing the same allowance against a target (a limit is not a target)
A second bar restating the same number in a different direction
